description:
The single largest missing unit operation. crates/outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs/src/ has heater, cooler, heat_exchanger, compressor, expander, pump, valve, mixer, splitter, separator, pipe and reactors — but no column.

SCOPE: multi-stage vapour-liquid column solving the MESH equations (material balance, equilibrium, summation, enthalpy balance), with condenser and reboiler, multiple feeds, side draws and pumparounds. Prefer the inside-out algorithm to reuse the existing flash_insideout.rs machinery rather than writing a new solver from scratch.

V&V per the workspace rule — methodology AND results: validate against a published test problem from the open distillation literature with the reference numbers, tolerances and the measured outcome recorded in the test doc comment.

Enum dispatch for column variants, no trait objects, no Box, no lifetime parameters.
title: refinery: rigorous distillation column (MESH equations, inside-out) in dwsim-libs

description:
Pump (components/pump.rs:14) has only specification: PumpSpecification and efficiency: Ratio. Zero geometry.

Note Pump::evaluate is inert (returns NotYetImplemented, discards its _inlet), though the underlying dwsim free function outram_park_fork_dwsim_libs::pump::modes::evaluate IS implemented and tested and returns head: Length -- but that is hydraulic head, NOT a size. Do not use it for visual scale.

Part of op-dt3.17. The digital-twin widget layer must derive a component's on-screen size from its REAL dimensions; the engine crate forbids new physics, so the dimension must exist here in tampines.

DO NOT use HemSteamCv::get_volume() as a size -- it is the thermodynamic control volume, caller-supplied and unvalidated, conventionally a 1 m3 dummy (get_ref_vol() returns exactly 1.0 m3). It describes the fluid parcel, not the machine.

Prefer explicit named dimensions where shape matters to the drawing; a single nominal Volume is acceptable where only a rough size correlation is wanted. Document units and valid ranges in the doc comment per the workspace human-interface rule, and keep uom types.
title: tampines Pump: add nominal size/envelope dimensions

description: multi_region::rbf_mapping::RbfFieldMap fits a full 3-D polyharmonic spline; a collinear (pure-axial) or coplanar sample set makes the linear polynomial tail rank-deficient => RbfMapError::Singular (documented + tested in build_rejects_collinear_samples). Add an active-dimension detection that reduces the spline to the spanned subspace so a 1-D axial power profile can be RBF-mapped directly.
title: genfoam multiRegion: dimension-reduced RBF for 1-D/2-D axial profiles
